scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run dev --workspace=apps/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/server && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/server && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
